gloss: one's circumstances; one's lot in life

definitions.gloss: one's circumstances; one's fate; one's personal history
definitions.explanation: Refers to a person's life situation, personal background, or the circumstances they find themselves in. Often carries a nuance of hardship or sympathy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{身|み}の{上|うえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}った→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
examples.english: She told the story of her life.
No one knows what happened to him.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{身|み}の{上|うえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧で、⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}れない→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: I'm so worried about my son's well-being that I can't sleep at night.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身|み}の{上|うえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧ (to tell one's life story)
- {身|み}の{上|うえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{案|あん}じる→案じる：19881_anjiru⟧ (to worry about someone's well-being)
- {身|み}の{上|うえ}{話|ばなし} (a personal story; life story)
- {身|み}の{上|うえ}⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧ (a personal advice column/consultation)

USAGE:
{身|み}の{上|うえ}⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧ is a well-known newspaper feature where readers write in about personal problems. {身|み}の{上|うえ}{話|ばなし} often implies a tale of hardship or an emotional personal account.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{境遇|きょうぐう}→境遇：12097_kyouguu⟧: circumstances, situation — more formal and literary
- ⟦{生|お}い{立|た}ち→生い立ち：09351_oitachi⟧: upbringing — focuses specifically on how one was raised
- ⟦{身分|みぶん}→身分：00278_mibun⟧: social status — focuses on rank or position in society
